Hamster Idle Pack

Six games dug out by hamsters: four cosy idle games and two bouncy action games. Pick a chamber. Level up your burrow card, collect badges and climb the leaderboards.

DIG IN ▼

Bouncy Barrels

Hamster pumpjacks in wells that go deeper and deeper. Haul the crude up, fill the storage tank and sell when the oil price spikes.

Marble Works

Hamsters lift marbles to the top of a plinko board. Build ramps through the pegs, steer them into the rich edge cups and clear each board.

Hamster Harvest

THE NEST · −2.1 m

In a game, tap the house icon in the top bar (or press H) to come back up. Games pause down here, and the idle games pay out for the time away when you return.
